intent: Renders the approved design record into a clickable HTML prototype, styled from the design tokens verbatim — it renders, never redesigns — with a coverage gate over every screen and every navigation link.

dimensions.name: renders-not-redesigns
dimensions.criterion: Renders the design record verbatim from its tokens; it never redesigns.

dimensions.name: coverage-gate
dimensions.criterion: A coverage gate fails the prototype if a screen has no page or a navigation link dangles.

dimensions.name: reads-design-record
dimensions.criterion: Reads the 02a-plan-design record and records the 02b-prototype artifact.
